description: Fetch a time series from Bank of Korea ECOS. Pass stat_code + cycle (A/Q/M/D) + start/end period. Date format matches the cycle: yearly = "2024", quarterly = "2024Q3", monthly = "202403", daily = "20240315". Optionally narrow to specific item_code(s) via item1/item2/item3/item4. Returns rows with stat_name, item_name, unit, time, data_value. Use after ecos_search_tables + ecos_series_items to discover codes.

cycle.description: Cycle: A (annual), Q (quarterly), M (monthly), D (daily), SM (semi-monthly).

item1.description: Optional item filter (e.g., "0000001" for USD in the exchange-rate table).

start.description: Start period in cycle's native format (e.g., "2024" / "2024Q1" / "202401" / "20240101").

stat_code.description: Statistic code (e.g., "901Y009" for CPI, "731Y001" for exchange rates).

name: ecos_get_series
